timeline.message:
Remove `MockSinglePrioritizingExecutor`

`MockSinglePrioritizingExecutor` contains a hack that stops working with
JDK19 which introduces a different way to start threads. This commit
removes the hack and captures the tasks to be executed as they're passed
to the executor instead.

It turns out this hack was also apparently swallowing some tripping
assertions, so this commit fixes those assertions.

Closes #86880
timeline.author: David Turner
